snippet.title: WipEout Portable Collection | WipEout Pure | Perfect Descension
snippet.description:
In this video, I play through the entire Descension tournament from WipEout Pure without any deaths or losses, similarly to how Perfect Meltdown is done in WipEout HD Fury. I also used the Expert AI DLC to make the AI more challenging, just like with Perfect Meltdown where you race against the Elite AI. This is slightly more difficult than Perfect Meltdown, but it is still possible to get through the tournament perfectly, and feels very rewarding once you do succeed. This was a lot of fun to do, and if you're looking for something challenging to do in a WipEout game, I definitely recommend trying this out! :)

I was going to do the Reminiscence tournament instead, but after so many tries, I just couldn't get through it perfectly. It especially gets tougher on the zone tracks because there are no weapon pads to slow down the opponents. I decided that it would be a better idea to do the Descension tournament instead, as it was more possible to get through perfectly. I might try doing the Reminiscence tournament again at some point to see if I can get through it perfectly, and if I do succeed, I might make a video of it. My apologies to those who wanted to see that instead ^^'

Challenge Rules:

1. The Expert AI DLC must be installed
2. Similar to Perfect Meltdown, you need to win 1st place on every track, and you cannot get eliminated
3. Speed class should be Phantom
4. You need to be using the WipEout Portable Collection version of WipEout Pure or WipEout Pure Special Edition to do this challenge

Mods Used:

1. WipEout Portable Collection by NR74W
2. Expert AI DLC
3. Custom Music
4. HD Texture Pack by NR74W

Music: (Audio muffled in some parts, for obvious reasons... Couldn't make the music quiet enough)

1. Tarik 'N' DJMael - Wanted Punk (DLC Soundtrack)
2. The Breakfastaz - The Pressure (Album: Ultimate Breakbeat Bass)
3. Ed Rush, Optical - Space Monkey (Album: Travel the Galaxy by Ed Rush & Optical)
4. LFO - Flu-Shot (Base Game Soundtrack)
5. Oblivion - The Butterfly Effect (DLC Soundtrack)
6. Oblivion Ft Jaye & Calver - Disconnect (DLC Soundtrack)
7. Kosheen - Mannequin (Lee Coombs Remix) (Album: Mannequin by Kosheen)
8. LFO - Flu-Shot (Again...)
9. Elite Force - Cross The Line (Base Game Soundtrack)
10. Aphex Twin - Naks Acid (Base Game Soundtrack)
11. Tiësto - Goldrush (Base Game Soundtrack)
12. Voice of cod - Bubbles of Nothing (DLC Soundtrack)
